)

class ToxicClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Embedding(max_length + 1, embedding_dim)
        self.hidden = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(embedding_dim, 512), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(512, num_classes), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.loss_fn = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

    def forward(self, text_input):
        batch_sizes = text_input.size(0)
        encoded_embeddings = self.encoder(text_input)
        pooled = encoded_embeddings.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.hidden(pooled)
        logits = self.classifier(x)
        return logits

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(batch_texts)
